**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation restriction on Bluefly. The two candidate homes contain nothing responsive:

- **§ 14.8 (Personnel)** deals only with each party's supervision/direction of its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel, and IBM's subcontracting rights.
- **§ 14.16 (Freedom of Action)** is affirmatively favourable: "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others."

Document-wide searches for *solicit*, *hire*, *employ or engage*, *induce*, *recruit*, *employees of the other party*, and consent-gated restrictive language returned no hits. There is no no-hire clause and no duration or scope issue to narrow, so the preferred element ("Customer has no non-solicitation restriction") is already satisfied and no redline was proposed.
